notes.title: SteamOs & Steam Deck Support Added
notes.content:
The Pinball Neon Update for SteamOS and Steam Deck brings an electrifying new look and optimized performance to your favorite pinball tables. This update introduces a bold neon aesthetic, featuring glowing visuals, dynamic lighting effects, and vibrant color schemes that make the game feel more immersive than ever. Whether you’re playing docked on a monitor or on the go with your Steam Deck, the neon-infused experience delivers arcade-style excitement like never before.

Gameplay enhancements include refined ball physics, smoother flipper response, and optimized performance for SteamOS, ensuring every shot, bumper hit, and ramp interaction feels natural and precise. The update also introduces animated neon signs, pulsing lights, and reactive particle effects, creating a visually striking atmosphere that complements the fast-paced action.

For Steam Deck users, the game has been fine-tuned to run seamlessly, with optimized controls, improved battery efficiency, and customizable settings to ensure the best experience on a portable device. Whether using touchscreen controls, thumbsticks, or gyro aiming, gameplay remains smooth and intuitive.

New leaderboards and achievements have been added, allowing players to compete globally and challenge friends to beat their high scores. The update also includes enhanced multiplayer modes, ensuring intense pinball action whether you’re playing solo or competing against others.

Additionally, various bug fixes, UI improvements, and performance enhancements have been implemented, ensuring a polished experience across SteamOS and Steam Deck.

Get ready to experience the Pinball Neon Update today! Whether you’re at home or on the go, this update brings stunning neon aesthetics, refined gameplay, and optimized performance for an unbeatable pinball experience on SteamOS and Steam Deck.

notes.title: Mac Support Added
notes.content:
The Pinball Neon Update for Steam on macOS brings an electrifying new look and enhanced gameplay experience to your favorite pinball tables. This update introduces a stunning neon-themed visual overhaul, adding vibrant colors, glowing effects, and dynamic lighting that make the action feel more immersive than ever. Whether you’re a seasoned pinball wizard or a newcomer, the fresh aesthetics and smooth gameplay optimisations will take your experience to the next level.

With enhanced physics and refined ball movement, the Neon Update ensures precise and realistic gameplay, making every shot, bumper hit, and ramp interaction more satisfying. The tables now feature animated neon signs, pulsing lights, and electrifying particle effects, bringing a futuristic arcade vibe straight to your screen.

Performance has been fine-tuned for macOS users, ensuring smooth gameplay with optimised graphics settings, improved frame rates, and better compatibility with Apple’s latest hardware. Whether you’re playing on an M1/M2 MacBook or a high-end iMac, the game delivers a seamless experience.

New leaderboards and achievements have been integrated, allowing players to challenge their friends and climb the ranks with skill-ful plays. Customisable UI settings also let you tweak brightness and color schemes to match your preferences, ensuring that the neon glow isn’t too overwhelming.

For those who love multiplayer action, the update brings improved online leaderboards and competitive modes, so you can battle for high scores against players worldwide. Additionally, bug fixes and minor gameplay enhancements have been made, ensuring a smoother and more engaging pinball experience.

Dive into the Pinball Neon Update today on Steam for macOS and experience the next level of digital pinball excitement with stunning neon aesthetics, improved performance, and enhanced gameplay features!
